description: Intent i007 (branch=uapi-double-fetch, snapshot s02) complete. FINDING: s02:drivers/usb/core/devio.c:1804-1815 (low confidence) — USBDEVFS_SUBMITURB double fetch. Untrusted source: the ioctl argument buffer is user memory concurrently writable by a second thread. Violated invariant: proc_submiturb() snapshots the whole struct usbdevfs_urb once via copy_from_user(&uurb, arg, sizeof(uurb)) (line 1807) and proc_do_submiturb() validates number_of_packets from that kernel copy ('uurb->number_of_packets < 1 || > 128' lines 1551-1553, isofrmlen derived at 1556-1557), but the pointer consumed by 'isopkt = memdup_user(iso_frame_desc, isofrmlen)' (line 1559) is a SECOND independent fetch of the same user location — '(((struct usbdevfs_urb __user *)arg)->iso_frame_desc)' (line 1812) — while the kernel-copy uurb.iso_frame_desc is discarded. Unsafe use: the re-fetched buffer's isopkt[u].length values flow into the URB iso descriptors programmed to the host controller (lines 1724-1726). Identical double fetch in the compat path proc_submiturb_compat() (line 2016 after get_urb32()'s single copy_from_user at 1992). No kernel OOB was demonstrated (re-fetched pointer consumed only via memdup_user with per-element length checks < 49152), so this is a mechanism-match hypothesis at low confidence: a racing writer can substitute which user buffer backs the validated packet count. NEGATIVE evidence: 10 further candidates classified safe after deep reading (genwqe reg ioctls, v4l2-compat-ioctl32 — its re-fetches are re-validated on the consuming copy, comedi_compat32, capi.c, tty_io.c TIOCSSERIAL, fs/select.c fdsets, net/compat.c cmsg walker, hpsa passthru compat, trace_get_user, sbuslib). Bounded by: whole-tree static scanners (597 dense fetch windows, 564 same-pointer repeat pairs, outputs under agent-state/tmp/proj_001-i007-explore) with only ~12 clusters deeply read; unexamined clusters include arch/*/kernel/signal*.c sigreturn frame parsing, fs/xfs/xfs_ioctl32.c bulkstat, sound compat, v4l2 non-window ioctls, drm_ioc32, kernel/compat.c, fs/compat_ioctl.c, net/sctp/socket.c, megaraid, infiniband ucm/ucma/uverbs, KVM compat, and mtdchar MEMWRITE/MEMERASE family. No runtime race reproducer or KCSAN run was performed (read-only tree). Structured artifact: agent-state/findings/i007.json (snapshots_checked=["s02"], findings=1, candidates=12).
